tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Think about the people you are close to, like your family or classmates. What genres of films do they usually find most appealing? For instance, are they more into science fiction or romantic comedies.
tasks.analysis: 中文：想一想你亲近的人，比如你的家人或同学。他们通常最喜欢什么类型的电影？例如，他们更喜欢科幻片还是浪漫喜剧片？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Regarding your weekly schedule, do you find it enjoyable to watch a movie on a weekday evening once your work or school day is over? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：关于你每周的日程安排，当你在工作日晚上结束了一天的工作或学习后，你觉得看一部电影是一种享受吗？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Nowadays, streaming movies at home has become the norm for many. In your view, do you think theaters will disappear in the future?
tasks.analysis: 中文：如今，在家流媒体播放电影已经成为许多人的常态。在你看来，电影院未来会消失吗？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: It is often argued that films serve a greater purpose than mere entertainment, such as educating the public on global or social concerns. What is your perspective on the role of movies as teaching tools?
tasks.analysis: 中文：人们常常认为，电影的作用不仅仅是娱乐，比如还可以就全球或社会问题对公众进行教育。你对电影作为教育工具的角色有什么看法？
tasks.title: Interview
